name: GTFOBins (structured summaries)
title: GTFOBins — Unix Binary Abuse
description: Structured summaries of how common Unix binaries can be abused (SUID/sudo/capabilities) to break out of restricted contexts or escalate. Each entry records binary, function, prerequisite, example intent, risk, detection and mitigation, with a link to the canonical GTFOBins page.
licence: GTFOBins is published under its own licence (see the upstream repository, historically GPL/CC-style). This pack contains original structured summaries and detection/mitigation guidance authored for Oyster with attribution and links, not a copy of the GTFOBins dataset.
attribution: GTFOBins — https://gtfobins.github.io/ (Emilio Pinna, Andrea Cardaci, contributors).
approval_requirements: Describes local escalation primitives. Any active use requires an authorized, in-scope host and approval; the knowledge itself is read-only and pairs with detection + mitigation.
scope_requirements: Authorized target host required before any technique is executed.
freshness_policy: Review semi-annually against the GTFOBins catalogue.
